about: The core's licence audit (floor rule 10): what its own workflows and scripts use, held to the tools' list by scripts/licences.mjs with .github/licences.json, which the core's tests workflow runs. Nothing of the core ships. A project's scan leaves its copy of the core out, since this audit holds it; its own uses of the same actions are in its own audit. The scan's own script and test are left out of the scan, since they name the forms it looks for.
